The Topology Boundary Auditor (mask confidence 0.98) and Geometric Depth Auditor found no structural issues, confirming the subject is well-grounded and topologically sound. The severity of the compression is low enough that it does not significantly detract from the overall quality, but it prevents a perfect artifact score.
